title: Chat, Modes & Context Lanes | ContextMint Docs
description: Ask, Plan, and Agent modes; Repo, Work, and Hybrid context lanes; optional Plan Studio and EPA (defaults off); file and image attachments, sessions, provenance chips, and Work-lane auto-suggest.
lead: ContextMint chat is a governed copilot — not a generic web chat. You choose how much autonomy the model has (mode) and what evidence it may use (context lane).

opening.title: Opening chat
items: Shortcut: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> (Windows/Linux; macOS may differ per keymap)

rows.behavior: Q&A and explanations; no autonomous file edits
Structured plans and todos; still human-gated before apply. Optional Plan Studio / EPA planes stay off until enabled — see Planning below.
Proposes patches and assisted actions; gate 2 preview before writes

lanes.title: Context lanes: Repo, Work, Hybrid
lanes.intro: Open the compose ⋯ menu → Context to select a lane. The choice persists per workspace.

rows.retrieval: Knowledge objects when available, then hybrid search (vector + BM25), window expansion, workspace grep, and dependency-graph neighbours
rows.bestFor: “What does our code do?” — answers only from assembled evidence

rows.retrieval: Session packs + attachments + editor selection — no vector repo search
rows.bestFor: Planning, stakeholder comms, concepts — job-relevant but not file lookups

rows.retrieval: Full evidence assembly (same as Repo) plus labeled recommendations
rows.bestFor: “Should we ship X?” — repo evidence plus labeled recommendations

evidenceAssembly.title: How evidence is assembled (Repo / Hybrid)
evidenceAssembly.before: ContextMint works on any indexed workspace — not one repo layout. For structural questions (for example route wiring), the server uses index-time knowledge objects when the registry has a hit. For semantic questions, it runs hybrid search, then expands around hits: file windows, workspace grep, and dependency-graph neighbours. Optional LLM evidence selection is tier-gated and off by default — inference is last resort, not the primary path. See

provenance.title: Provenance chips (answers)
provenance.intro: After a response, you may see a small label such as:
items: From your codebase — Repo lane with retrieved chunks
Work notes — Work lane (packs/attachments, not a repo search)
No repo matches — Repo lane found little indexed context

autoSuggest.title: Work-lane auto-suggest
autoSuggest.text: On Repo lane, if retrieval is weak for a planning-style question, ContextMint may show a banner: “Little repo context matched — retry in Work lane?” Click Use Work lane to re-send the same question without vector search.

attachments.title: Attachments & context files
items: Use the attach control to pin files as chips before sending
Attached paths get full-fidelity chunks in the assembler prompt
Open editor files are boosted in search and indexed with priority

images.title: Image evidence (screenshots)
images.p1: Paste, drag-drop, or pick PNG, JPEG, or WebP images in the compose bar. Image chips appear beside file chips. Context Lens shows thumbnails and the vision route (local by default) before you send.
items: Local Ollama vision is the default — no cloud API key required to attach images
Repo and Hybrid lanes combine images with retrieved code; Work lane combines images with packs
Use Run visual audit in Lens for ARGUS structured findings (separate from chat Q&A)

sessions.title: Chat sessions
sessions.text: Start a new session from the session list; history is stored per workspace up to configured limits. Sessions are local to your machine (or your team server in enterprise mode).

routing.title: Model routing
routing.text: Compose bar model selector: Auto, Local (Ollama), or Cloud when BYOK is enabled. The routing badge on answers shows which tier ran.

planning.title: Plan mode → Studio → EPA → Save (defaults off)
planning.intro: Plan mode can emit structured PlanIR. Optional planes (all default off) sit between proposal and persist:
items: Save Plan / PAEP — only path that persists an authoritative plan under .contextmint/plans/

Plan Studio — verify EXISTING claims, sanitize unsupported assertions, freeze exportable PlanIR snapshots under .contextmint/studio/. Improves proposal cleanliness — not authority. Enable contextmint.planStudio.enabled (extension) and chat.plan_studio.enabled (server).
EPA (Engineering Plan Arbitration) — compare ordinary writer PlanIRs, re-observe FACT, record a RESOLUTION. Does not Save. Enable contextmint.planArbitration.enabled / chat.plan_arbitration.enabled.
planning.note: Studio freeze is not an EPA decision. EPA must re-observe FACT independently. PAEP alone authorizes persistence.

blocked.title: When chat is blocked
blocked.p1: Send is blocked only when readiness is offline, starting, or error.
blocked.p2: Indexing does not block send — answers improve as more files finish indexing.
